items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Barney Bigard was in the band -- the tenor player, clarinet. And Omar Simeon was in the band.

ctx.x: even. I hadn't even heard of him before. And I didn't know him or anything like that... But he was standing up in featured in the band, he did all the trumpet work. And I expected to hear King Oliver play, but he wasn't playing. His teeth were bad or something -- he was having trouble.

Barney Bigard was in the band -- the tenor player, clarinet. And Omar Simeon was in the band. I forget what the tenor player's name was. There was another saxophone man. Anyway, I didn't know too many of the members of the band. Paul Barbarin was the drummer.
But they didn't stay around New York. They finished their engagement at the Savoy, and the band got into some hard times. And the majority of them went back to Chicago.
